rule17_note: Truth docs are born-JSON streams; this index names every documentation surface and folder so any reader finds a document without guessing.

surfaces.name: docs/
surfaces.purpose: Committed truth streams (born-JSON): PRD, architecture, pseudocode, atomic functions, development order + requirements/ PSRS suites. Gitignored on dev by store policy — committed copy travels via the db-store lane (AGENTS Q9) and projections via store-projector.

folders.docs/requirements/: PSRS requirement suites (one JSON per initiative) — DOC.2 grouping by feature/initiative.
folders.docs/design_audit/: Design audit HTML artifacts referenced by requirements.
folders.docs/features/: reserved — per-group feature-spec + component map (DOC.2/5); materializes with first real doc (DOC.14); goals grandfathered in frontend/confirmed/goals/ until migration ordered.

surfaces.name: .IDE_Plans/
surfaces.purpose: Session-local planning: brainstorm, outline, stage plans, audit_reports (AGY verdicts), design_drafts. Fully gitignored; persisted via DB projection.

folders..IDE_Plans/audit_reports/: Per-track AGY audit reports (HTML) — verdict history.

surfaces.name: frontend/confirmed/
surfaces.purpose: Design & approval reference (Q13 bucket B): locked page designs, essentials, themes, handoff docs. INDEX.json maps page folders; feature specs + traceability live beside their page (DOC.5).

folders.frontend/confirmed/essentials/: Foundation standards: app_essentials (16+ essentials), app_components registry, app_structure contract, app_features.
folders.frontend/confirmed/goals/: Goals page: locked base, features (36), components (21), traceability, feature_spec (canonical template home — DOC.2).
folders.frontend/confirmed/<page>/: watchlist · dashboard · portfolio · settings · alerts · search · csv_export · about · app_frame — per-page design + handoff docs.

folders.docs/architecture/decisions/001-docs-str: Docs layout contract (DOC.9/10/13/15/16) — the structure decision record.
folders.docs/architecture/decisions/002-docs-fol: Folder tree planned before first document (features/api/onboarding/operations recorded, created on demand).

surfaces.name: reserved (created on demand — DOC.14)
surfaces.purpose: Standard top-level set from DOC.9 exists in the contract; folders materialize only when real documents need them.

folders.docs/features/: reserved — feature specs live per-page under frontend/confirmed/<page>/ today; moves need ADR.
folders.docs/api/: reserved — API/endpoint reference, separate from onboarding (DOC.4); created when endpoint docs accumulate.

link_rule: References only forward: foundation (essentials) must not link down to feature specs — go through this INDEX (DOC.11).
owner_rule: Every folder above has an owner in .github/CODEOWNERS (DOC.12).
